name: Legend Lore

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each

summary: Learn the significant lore about a famous person, place or object you name.
text: The more you already know or hold of the subject, the clearer the answer; for something obscure you may learn nothing.
